courses.title: Sprite Lab
courses.description: Learn to build interactive stories and games using Code.org's Sprite Lab. Start with the basics and work your way up to creating your own storyboarded project.

courses.title: Tinkercad Circuits Lab
courses.description: Learn to send electricity around a loop and keep your lights safe with resistors. Then learn to use buttons and knobs to turn your lights on, dim them, and mix your own colors!
